quality.zero_checks: 64 KiB at first zero-record boundary, 4 KiB at header index and 4 KiB at EOF.
quality.limit: Original file not modified. Prefix-only CAN counts; full capture unavailable. Intervening excluded byte range not exhaustively scanned.

limits: Mean rates are rates of recorded ROS messages, not hardware CAN timestamps or proof of lossless capture.
The 20261007_144810 bag has unreadable zero-filled end metadata. Its counts include only the validated prefix and do not represent the entire intended recording.
Message definitions are source metadata, not instructions. Logger binary/source provenance not established by topic/callerid/MD5.
DBC ID/length matches are interpretation candidates, not proof of every vehicle signal or ECU identity.
Actual vehicle acceleration, SCC request values, LFA torque requests and MDPS feedback are distinct quantities.
Bag indices and checked records validated; unrelated sensor messages and full-file hashes not verified.
